# Yassine Chandid — Technical Lead & Architect

> Yassine Chandid is a technical lead and architect based in Casablanca, Morocco (GMT+0). He builds fast, modern web, mobile, and desktop apps with React, Next.js, and TypeScript — then ships them and keeps them running. This site (yassinech.com) is his portfolio: selected work, a full project index, and small free developer tools.

## About

- Name: Yassine Chandid
- Role: Technical Lead & Architect
- Location: Casablanca, Morocco (GMT+0)
- Focus: React, Next.js, TypeScript, full-stack web, mobile (React Native), desktop
- Contact: me@yassinech.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/jakcal
- Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/chandid_yassine

## Site pages

- [Home](https://yassinech.com/): Intro, what clients say, stack, and highlights.

## Clients

- Ministère de l'Intérieur (Morocco) — GPEEC, the national workforce-planning platform. [Case study](https://yassinech.com/projects/gpeec)
- SRM (Société Régionale Multiservices) — MyDEV, an HR self-service platform in production across several regions. Led the dev team and ran the security audits.
- AOS — the employee association of SRM. MyAOS member portal and back-office.
- UDAT — delivery partner for GPEEC and AOS.
- Eventflo — events platform. https://eventflo.io/
- Putora — job marketplace, built and delivered for the client. [Case study](https://yassinech.com/projects/putora)
- Real Dating Now (Shinjiro Group) — dating app. https://realdatingnow.com/

## Featured projects

- GPEEC — National workforce-planning platform. Air-gapped, on-prem AI classification, passed government security audits.
- AOS (SRM) — Member portal and back-office with a configurable workflow engine.
- Putora — Job marketplace built and delivered for a client. Four production surfaces. [Case study](https://yassinech.com/projects/putora)
- AnimeHub — Anime streaming app. 5M+ downloads.
- Modus — Business management system: stock, orders, customers, multi-organization workspaces, and a hospitality module (hostels and short-stay rentals) with a direct-booking storefront. In production. [Case study](https://yassinech.com/projects/modus)
- MockupViews — Canvas mockup & video studio. 2k+ daily users. [Case study](https://yassinech.com/projects/mockupviews)

## Tools

- [Markdown to PDF](https://yassinech.com/MarkdownToPdf): Paste Markdown, get a clean PDF. Runs fully in the browser — nothing uploaded. Source: https://github.com/jakcal/MarkdownToPdf
- [Stateless Password Generator](https://yassinech.com/stateless-password-generator): Same settings always produce the same strong password, so nothing is stored. Source: https://github.com/jakcal/stateless-password-generator
